reasoning: Pointwise log loss optimizes absolute calibration rather than relative ranking order. Since GAUC and nDCG evaluate within-user ranking order, BPR pairwise loss directly optimizes pairwise concordance (GAUC) and ranking performance without wasting model capacity on absolute probability calibration or uninformative user/item biases.
